articles.title: Hurricane Nolo: Slow, Soaking, and Strengthening Toward Hawaii
articles.summary: Hurricane Nolo is crawling toward Hawaii at 5 mph, and forecasters warn it could dump up to 2 feet of rain. A hurricane watch is up for the Big Island as the storm keeps getting stronger.

articles.title: Supreme Court Blocks Trump-Backed Missouri Map, Citing 'Electoral Chaos'
articles.summary: The Supreme Court rejected a Trump-backed Missouri voting map for the third time, saying switching districts mid-election would cause chaos. Absentee voting is already underway under the old 2022 map.

articles.title: Iran Offers 7-Day Deal to Reopen Strait of Hormuz, but US Remains Skeptical
articles.summary: Iran says it can reopen the Strait of Hormuz within a week if the US meets conditions from a June agreement. The strait is a crucial oil route, and talks have collapsed before.
